lines: Ab ke hum bichhre to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milen
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps someday we will meet in dreams.

lines: Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milen
couplets.en: The way we come upon dried flowers in books.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhre to shayad
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps.

lines: Dhoond ujre hue logon mein wafa ke moti
couplets.en: Seek pearls of faithfulness among those whose lives have fallen apart.

lines: Ye khazane tujhe mumkin hai kharabon mein milen
couplets.en: You may find these treasures among the ruins.

lines: Tu Khuda hai na mera ishq farishton jaisa
couplets.en: You are no god, and my love is nothing angelic.

lines: Dono insaan hain to kyun itne hisabon mein milen
couplets.en: We are both human, so why keep such careful accounts when we meet?

lines: Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milen
couplets.en: The way we come upon dried flowers in books.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhre to shayad
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps.

lines: Gham-e-duniya bhi gham-e-yaar mein shamil kar lo
couplets.en: Let the world's sorrows mingle with the sorrow of missing your beloved.

lines: Nasha barhta hai sharaben jo sharabon mein milen
couplets.en: The intoxication deepens when one wine mingles with another.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhre to shayad
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps.

lines: Ab na main hoon na tu hai na woh maazi hai Faraz
couplets.en: Faraz, you and I and all that was are gone now.

lines: Jaise do saaye tamanna ke sarabon mein milen
couplets.en: As though two shadows met in the mirages of desire.
